task_grounding:
Open OBS Studio and set up a green-screen keyed layout.

1. OBS may start with a default 'Scene' — delete it.
2. Create a scene named exactly 'Live'.
3. In the 'Live' scene, add an Image source named exactly 'WebCam' whose file is /home/user/Pictures/green_plate.png.
4. Apply a Chroma Key filter to the 'WebCam' source. Name the filter exactly 'Green Screen'.
5. Configure the filter: Key Color Type = Green, Similarity = 420, Smoothness = 100.
6. Make sure the 'WebCam' source is visible (eye icon enabled).
7. Close OBS or let it auto-save so the scene collection JSON is written.

verification.description: 'Green Screen' filter is a chroma key filter
Chroma key color type set to green
